answer_1.quote: We develop the first framework for expanding agenda-based dialogue simulation (Schatzmann and  to a multimodal embodied agent setup by augmenting agenda-based dialogue act prediction with a rule-based module for identifying action sequences in the environment to complete tasks.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models based on the success rate (SR) and goal condition success rate (GC) as defined in the original TEACh paper.
